_comment: Template egg for the Econ Game Python worker (uv)
name: Econ Worker (Python)
description: Async tick runner implemented in Python/uv
startup: set -eu; cd -- "{{WORK_DIR}}"; if [ -f uv.lock ]; then uv sync --frozen --no-dev; else uv sync --no-dev; fi; uv run "{{START_CMD}}"

installation.script:
#!/bin/bash
set -euo pipefail
apt update
apt install -y git curl jq file unzip make gcc g++ python3 python-is-python3 libtool
mkdir -p /mnt/server
cd /mnt/server

if [ "${USER_UPLOAD}" == "true" ] || [ "${USER_UPLOAD}" == "1" ]; then
    echo 'User will upload files. Skipping git clone.'
    exit 0
fi

if [[ -z "${GIT_ADDRESS}" ]]; then
    echo 'Set USER_UPLOAD=1 or provide a public HTTPS repository address.'
    exit 1
fi
case "${GIT_ADDRESS}" in
  https://*) ;;
  *) echo 'Only public HTTPS repository addresses are accepted.'; exit 1 ;;
esac
case "${GIT_ADDRESS#https://}" in
  *@*|*[?]*|*[#]*) echo 'Repository URLs containing credentials or query data are forbidden.'; exit 1 ;;
esac

if [[ ${GIT_ADDRESS} != *.git ]]; then GIT_ADDRESS="${GIT_ADDRESS}.git"; fi

echo 'Cloning public repository...'
if [ -z "${BRANCH}" ]; then
  git clone -- "${GIT_ADDRESS}" .
else
  git check-ref-format --branch "${BRANCH}" >/dev/null
  git clone --single-branch --branch "${BRANCH}" -- "${GIT_ADDRESS}" .
fi

echo 'Done.'

variables.name: Git Repository Address
variables.description: Optional public HTTPS repository; credentials in URLs are rejected

variables.name: User Uploaded Files
variables.description: Skip cloning if user uploads files (1=true)

variables.name: Database URL
variables.description: Server-owned database credential; set only in the panel's protected secret field

variables.name: Redis URL
variables.description: Server-owned cache credential; set only in the panel's protected secret field
